component.name: SlashBeacon
component.summary: Desktop Identity Ground-Truth & Impersonation Prevention Console

description.p: SlashBeacon is an operator-focused desktop security console designed for Discord community stewardship. It monitors server member events in real-time, detecting homoglyphic spoofing, authoritative affix impersonation, and cloned avatars against verified identity benchmarks before malicious actors can defraud community members.

ul.li: Sub-50ms deterministic multi-script homoglyph evaluation (Cyrillic, Greek, Mathematical).
Perceptual discrete cosine transform (DCT) visual hash matching for avatar clones.
Cryptographic snowflake age analysis and automated compound threat adjudication.
Zero-telemetry architecture with local data sovereignty and encrypted OS Keychain credential storage.

description.p: Post-Mortem Release: Granular member removal with confirmation safety, disconnect flow stability, and refreshed UI showcase assets.
Production release of SlashBeacon featuring complete rebrand, UI stability improvements, and updated dependencies.
Production release of SlashBeacon with real-time Discord Gateway v10 monitoring and multi-tiered threat adjudication.
